description: This file defines FastAPI routes related to submissions in a data insights dashboard backend. It facilitates creating submissions, retrieving their details, triggering validation, and approving or rejecting submissions. The routes include detailed authorization and validation logic, and interact with services and schemas for processing submission workflows.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router instance setting up endpoints for submissions

methods.name: CreateSubmissionResponse create_submission( user=Security(get_current_user_dep), payload: dict = Body(default=None), )
methods.description: Handles creation of a data submission, including authorization, validation, and service invocation.

methods.name: GetSubmissionResponse get_submission( submission_id: str, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security), )
methods.description: Retrieves a submission's details by ID, including validation status.

methods.name: TriggerValidationResponse trigger_validation( submission_id: str, request: TriggerValidationRequest, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security), )
methods.description: Triggers a validation run for a specified submission.

methods.name: ApproveSubmissionResponse approve_submission( submission_id: str, request: ApproveSubmissionRequest, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security), )
methods.description: Handles approval or rejection of a submission, including signature validation and workflow orchestration.
